issue.title: BUG: Crosstab/Pivot_table columns.names change when toggling dropna

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

repository.name: pandas
repository.description: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more

issue.body:
This is not a real 'bug' maybe? But it can be annoying.

xref #12614. Independent of issue #12642.
#### Code Sample

```
a = np.array(['foo', 'foo', 'foo', 'bar', 'bar', 'foo', 'foo'], dtype=object)
b = np.array(['one', 'one', 'two', 'one', 'two', 'two', 'two'], dtype=object)
c = np.array(['dull', 'dull', 'dull', 'dull', 'dull', 'shiny', 'shiny'], dtype=object)
res_dropnaF = pd.crosstab(a, [b, c], rownames=['a'], colnames=['b', 'c'], dropna=False)
res_dropnaT = pd.crosstab(a, [b, c], rownames=['a'], colnames=['b', 'c'], dropna=True)
print res_dropnaF, '\n\n', res_dropnaT
```

Results:
`res_dropnaF` shows no`columns.names` (because they're removed) while `res_dropnaT` does.

```
     one        two      
    dull shiny dull shiny
a                        
bar    1     0    1     0
foo    2     0    1     2 

b    one  two      
c   dull dull shiny
a                  
bar    1    1     0
foo    2    1     2
```
#### Expected Output

Extra option or consistency on column names.
Should be fixed by working on `pivot_table(): if not dropna`
